title: fix(app-shell): Studio re-reads the open object, its extension and its form view on the in-tab copilot pulse
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao2W78H5Kr6zwkSbFLnJhbQk)_

Fixes #32610

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 数据支柱在同一标签页的副驾「存为草稿」或「全部撤销」之后,会按服务端草稿重新读取当前打开的对象、它的基础对象扩展和表单视图,字段属性栏、表单画布和头部读数不用刷新页面就跟上。
- 为什么改:之前副驾改完,属性栏没有「草稿」标记、帮助文字为空、画布看不到新字段,用户以为没改成功,会重复下指令,做出重复草稿。
- 风险与回滚:作者有未保存的编辑或保存还在进行时,重读会推迟到保存落地后再做,不会覆盖作者的改动;回滚就是撤掉这个 PR,行为回到「刷新页面才更新」。
- 先看:`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 的对象加载和扩展加载两个 effect(加载键多了重读计数、`refreshOnly` 保留选中字段);`useFormViewDraft.ts` 的加载依赖;`DataPillar.copilotDraftMarks-12725.test.tsx` 新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/DataPillar.copilotDraftMarks-12725.test.tsx`,预期 10 个测试全过,其中 4 个是本卡新增。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。
- 席位意见:席位(domain:ui#4)审过。第一版的表单视图在冲突后选「重新载入」时会被当成副驾重读而跳过安装,作者看不到已保存版本;返工一轮改为只在「仅重读计数变化」时才视为重读,并加了对照测试与消融。数据支柱两处加载本就按完整加载键判断,没有这个问题。只改 `@object-ui/app-shell`,不碰服务端,不加新机制(#32592 的待裁问题不受影响)。CI 全绿后按队列落地。

## What changes

The in-tab copilot already announces both its draft write and its undo on the assistant bus (`emitMetadataRefresh`, sent by `ChatPane`), and the Studio ledger and the Data rail already re-read on that pulse. The Data pillar's open-object load did not: it was keyed on object, publish nonce and conflict-reload nonce only, so the field inspector, the Form canvas and the header's own reading kept the pre-write buffer until a reload. This PR connects the existing pulse to the three loads that ignored it, and adds no new mechanism (no focus refetch, polling or server push; #32592's open decision is untouched).

- **`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, Data pillar:** `useMetadataRefreshNonce(objBuffersHeld)` where `objBuffersHeld = dirty || extDirty || saving !== false`. The object load and the base-object extension load add that nonce to their load key and their dependencies. A load whose only change is the nonce is `refreshOnly`: it keeps the selected field and the shown extension in place while it reads, and replaces only what they show. After a refresh lands, one effect drops the selected field only if the re-read no longer has it (a discard took it away). An edit begun while the re-read was in flight keeps its buffer, and its save stays pinned to the read it was made on, so the version guard asks the author about a conflict instead of the re-read overwriting the edit.
- **`useFormViewDraft.ts`:** the same pulse, held by the form view buffer's own `dirty || saving`, re-reads the form view the Form tab edits. As in the Data pillar's loads, only a run whose pulse alone moved is held: the load compares a base key (view, package, publish nonce, reload nonce, customizing), so a conflict's "reload", a publish or a new view replaces the buffer whatever it holds.
- **`studioItemDraftStatus.ts`:** docblock only. It said the pillar's own reading is never re-read on the pulse; it now says the Data pillar re-reads it (held while the author has unsent work) and other pillars read their item once.
- **The header draft count (card step 5):** it already reads the `_drafts` ledger, which re-reads on the pulse. It cleared after an undo on `main` at unit level too (as `domain:ui#2` measured), so it gets a regression pin here and no code change. The staging residue in the card stays NOT MEASURED (an older console build, or read-after-write lag on `_drafts`).

## Tests

Four new pins, each a top-level `describe` in the component's existing harness:

- `DataPillar.copilotDraftMarks-12725.test.tsx`: (1) the open field properties re-read on the pulse (the copilot chip, the copilot's help text, a field the same draft added shows on the Form canvas, and the rail stays open); a re-read that no longer has the open field closes its properties; (3) CONTROL: a pulse during an unsent save is held, so nothing is re-read or replaced until the save lands, then it is re-read (deferred, not dropped); CONTROL: a pulse re-reads the open object only, never another object in the rail.
- `StudioDesignSurface.itemDraftLine-12725.test.tsx`: (2) with the object opened WITH a draft, the header's draft line ("Draft · 2 unpublished") goes once the undo empties the ledger, and the pillar re-reads its own reading. The file's docblock and one comment that said the pillar never re-reads on the pulse are corrected.
- `DataPillar.baseObjectExtension-28575.test.tsx`: an extension draft the copilot writes at the pair is re-read on the pulse and its field shows in the Form.
- `DataPillar.formViewLayout-30057.test.tsx`: a form view draft the copilot writes is re-read on the pulse and the canvas shows its sections; CONTROL: a dirty form view buffer refused as stale (409) is replaced by the saved version when the author picks "reload" (the pulse hold never holds a reload).

The three DataPillar harnesses now import `@objectstack/lint` at module top (the `check:test-source-alias` convention for edited files that reach its lazy import).

- A2, the pulse no longer held by the buffers (`useMetadataRefreshNonce(false)`): exactly the held-save CONTROL goes red (1 failed, 9 passed).

- A4, the form view load without the refresh nonce in its dependencies: the form view pin goes red (1 failed, 7 passed).
- A5, the form view's `refreshOnly` made coarse again (any re-run of the same view): the conflict-reload CONTROL goes red (1 failed, 8 passed).

## Acceptance notes

- A package publish bumps `publishNonce` and also emits the pulse, so the open object's load runs once for the publish and the pulse-keyed run cancels the first in-flight read. One extra read request, no behaviour change.
- The PR carries no assignee and requests no review, per the dispatch order: the seat lands it.
